//assert: Staged tightening (plan D-3). The PRD target is LCP <= 2500ms at error level, but
production currently sits near 4.0s, so a blanket 2500 error would leave CI red from
day one and destroy the signal value of the gate.
LHCI keys assertions by audit id in `level | [level, options]` form, so one audit
cannot carry both a 2500 warn and a 4500 error in the same set. Rather than a global
warn nobody reads, the ratchet is per-route via assertMatrix: once a route is measured
under 2500 (see .claude/PRPs/baselines/), move its pattern into a tighter matrix entry
so that route can never regress, while slower routes keep the 4500 ceiling.
Note the previous config's header comment in lighthouse.yml claimed 'Performance >=
0.95, LCP < 2.0s' while asserting 0.85/4500 — that drift is corrected here and there.
